title: Division Within 100 — No Remainders Worksheets
intro: Teach both meanings of division: equal sharing and making equal groups.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Use counters to share a total among a given number of groups. Then use the same total to make groups of a given size.

Example to work through together

Use the model below as you explain the example. Have your student point to the quantities as you discuss them.

Three plates, six counters on each, eighteen altogether.

18 ÷ 3 = 6
3 × 6 = 18

Ask your student

Are we finding the number of groups or the number in each group?

If your student needs help

If the student confuses the two, label the groups and the counters in one group before writing an equation.
